### Task 8.6: Release workflow passes the bare version

Decision: the version is worked out in a step of its own from `GITHUB_REF_NAME` (`v1.0.0` →
`1.0.0`) rather than taken from `docker/metadata-action`, whose `version` output is a `sha-…` tag
on a `workflow_dispatch` run. Tags keep `tags: ['v*']`; `bin/release-notes.sh` keeps taking the
tag (`v1.0.0`), which it already strips to find `## [1.0.0]`.

**Files:**

- Modify: `.github/workflows/release.yml` (job `image`: a new step before `- name: Build and
  push`, line 99; the `build-args` line 110)
- Modify: `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml` (line 37) and
  `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.yml` (line 39): the **Version** field asks for what the
  sidebar shows, so `placeholder: v1.0.0` becomes `placeholder: 1.0.0`
- Test: `tests/Unit/ProductionComposeTest.php` (new test at the end of the file)

**Interfaces:**

- Consumes: nothing new.
- Produces: step id `version` with output `value` in the `image` job.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

Append to `tests/Unit/ProductionComposeTest.php`:

```php
test('release images carry the bare version, while the git tags keep their v', function () {
    $workflow = (string) file_get_contents(dirname(__DIR__, 2).'/.github/workflows/release.yml');

    expect($workflow)->toContain("tags: ['v*']")
        ->toContain('run: echo "value=${REF#v}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"')
        ->toContain('VERSION=${{ steps.version.outputs.value }}')
        ->not->toContain('VERSION=${{ github.ref_name }}');

    foreach (['bug_report', 'feature_request'] as $template) {
        expect((string) file_get_contents(dirname(__DIR__, 2)."/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/{$template}.yml"))
            ->toContain("\n      placeholder: 1.0.0\n")
            ->not->toContain('placeholder: v1.0.0');
    }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Run it and watch it fail**

```bash
docker compose exec -T -u sail laravel.test bash -lc 'php artisan test --compact --filter="ProductionComposeTest"'
```

Expected: FAIL, the workflow does not contain `run: echo "value=${REF#v}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"`.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

In `.github/workflows/release.yml`, job `image`, insert before `      - name: Build and push`:

```yaml
      - name: Work out the version
        id: version
        env:
          REF: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: echo "value=${REF#v}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

```

and in `Build and push` replace

```yaml
          build-args: |
            VERSION=${{ github.ref_name }}
            REVISION=${{ github.sha }}
```

with

```yaml
          build-args: |
            VERSION=${{ steps.version.outputs.value }}
            REVISION=${{ github.sha }}
```

In `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml` (line 37) and
`.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.yml` (line 39) replace

```yaml
      placeholder: v1.0.0
```

with

```yaml
      placeholder: 1.0.0
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Run it and watch it pass**

```bash
docker compose exec -T -u sail laravel.test bash -lc 'php artisan test --compact --filter="ProductionComposeTest"'
```

Expected: PASS.

```markdown
1. **Applications** → **Add application**. A wizard creates the application and its
   environments together, in three steps:
    - **Application**: a name.
    - **Environments**: one per installation, with a name (`production`, `staging`, …), a
      type, the **Horizon URL**, the basic-auth user and password if the dashboard is behind
      one, and the **Collection interval** (15 to 300 seconds, in steps of 15: the scheduler
      queues readings every 15 seconds). The Horizon URL is the address of the Horizon
      dashboard as you open it in the browser, such as `https://shop.example.com/horizon`, or
      the moved address if the application changed `HORIZON_PATH`. The first row asks for it;
      every other row suggests one from it until you edit that row's URL by hand: the same
      host for a row whose name suggests Production, `<name>.<host>` for the others, so `staging` gets
      `https://staging.shop.example.com/horizon`. A first host that starts with the first
      row's name, such as `production.shop.example.com`, loses that label first. Give
      basic-auth credentials an `https://` address: over `http://` the password travels in
      clear on every poll, and the form warns you.
    - **Verify** reads every dashboard once and tells you what it found, or why it failed,
      before you save.

    The type is Production, Pre-production, Staging, Development, Testing or Demo. It gives the
    environment its colour, and members who see everything except production never see an
    environment of type Production. Until you pick one, the type follows the name:
    `production`, `prod`, `prd` or `live` suggest Production; `preprod`, `pre-production` or
    `uat` Pre-production; `staging` or `stage` Staging; `develop`, `development` or `dev`
    Development; `test`, `testing` or `qa` Testing; `demo` Demo; alone or followed by `-`, `.`
    or `_` and a suffix, such as `production-eu`. Any other name starts as Staging, so an
    environment is Production only when its name says so or you pick it.

    When you save, the panel trims the Horizon URL, writes its scheme and host in lower case
    and removes trailing slashes and a trailing `/api…` part:
    `https://Shop.example.com/horizon/api/stats/` is stored as `https://shop.example.com/horizon`.
    It refuses a scheme other than `http` and `https`, credentials, a query string or a
    fragment, and an IP address on a network the panel does not call (see
    [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)).

    **Add environment** on the application's page adds another one later. It suggests the
    Horizon URL in the same way, from the application's production environment (or its first
    one), and runs **Test connection** when you leave the URL field.
```

   `**A Horizon URL is refused when saved.**` with:

```markdown
**A Horizon URL or a webhook URL is refused when saved.** The panel refuses a scheme other
than `http` and `https`, credentials, a query string or a fragment in the URL. It also refuses
an IP address on a network it does not call, saying
_This address points to a network the panel does not call._ Link-local and cloud metadata
addresses are always refused; private networks, carrier-grade NAT (`100.64.0.0/10`, used by
Tailscale) included, are refused when `HORIZON_WATCH_BLOCK_PRIVATE_NETWORKS` is `true`. A host
name is not looked up when you save: it is resolved and checked at every call, so a Horizon URL
whose name resolves to a refused network fails its readings with _This address is not
allowed_, and a webhook delivery to such a name is logged as not delivered, _the address
points to a network the panel does not call_.
```

(The last italic phrase is the delivery error sentence of Batch 4 Task 4.9, key
`the address points to a network the panel does not call`; if Step 3 shows Batch 4 chose
another English text, use that.)

with:

```markdown
A new signing secret is issued, and shown once, when the first URL is saved, when the URL
moves to another host and when it is regenerated. A move to another host always issues a new
secret and forgets the old one at once, without the 24-hour previous signature: the receiver on
the old host knows the old secret and must not be able to sign for the new one. Give the new
secret to the new receiver before its first delivery. A change of path on the same host keeps
the secret, and removing the URL forgets it. After a regeneration, deliveries also carry
`X-Horizon-Watch-Previous-Signature`, made with the replaced secret, for 24 hours. Serve the
panel over HTTPS so that the page showing a secret can ask the browser to encrypt that history
entry — browsers only honour that in a secure context.
```

In `CONTRIBUTING.md`, after the last bullet of **Translations** (the bullet that starts

``the code in the `APP_LOCALE` row of the README.``), add:

```markdown

### Glossary

One concept, one word, in both languages. New strings and the documentation use these terms; a
string that needs another word for one of these concepts is a bug.

| English                           | Italian                                           | Rule                                                                                                                                 |
| --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Owner, Admin, Member, Viewer      | Proprietario, Amministratore, Membro, Osservatore | The four organization roles, printed from `TeamRole::label()`, never as the raw value. Admin names only the organization role.       |
| instance admin                    | amministratore dell’istanza                       | The panel-wide role of the account created at `/setup`; never shortened to admin.                                                    |
| Horizon URL                       | URL Horizon                                       | The Horizon dashboard address as opened in the browser, the only address an environment has; never domain, host or path.             |
| Type                              | Tipo                                              | The environment type: Production, Pre-production, Staging, Development, Testing, Demo. It sets the colour and what production means. |
| healthy                           | regolare                                          | Status `active`, and nothing else.                                                                                                   |
| needs attention                   | da gestire                                        | Every evaluated state that is not healthy: the filter, the KPI, the badge, the empty states. A paused collection is neither.         |
| alert, opened, resolved           | alert, aperto, risolto                            | The object and what happens to it; never anomaly or incident. The list is Open alerts / Alert aperti.                                |
| Mark as handled, Handled by …     | Segna come gestito, Gestito da …                  | The action, and the state it leaves.                                                                                                 |
| Mute                              | Silenzia                                          | Only the per-alert action.                                                                                                           |
| maintenance, Maintenance for…     | manutenzione, Manutenzione per…                   | Whatever creates a maintenance window.                                                                                               |
| Quiet hours                       | Fascia di quiete                                  | The daily hours, in the organization time zone, when only criticals go out.                                                          |
| Extra addresses                   | Indirizzi aggiuntivi                              | The admin list of email addresses beyond the members.                                                                                |
| destination                       | destinazione                                      | Any place a notification goes: an address or the webhook.                                                                            |
| signing secret                    | segreto di firma                                  | The key of the webhook signature, always by this name.                                                                               |
| Password needed                   | Password da inserire                              | The mark of an environment with a basic-auth user and no stored password, as an import leaves it; its collection stays paused.       |
| Log in, Log out                   | Accedi, Esci                                      | The login and logout actions, in every label and text.                                                                               |

Delivery errors are sentences (`deliveryErrorLabel` in `resources/js/lib/alerts.ts`), never the
codes of `App\Enums\DeliveryError`.
```

## Batch 9: Configuration export and import

Goal: an organization's applications, environments and alert rules travel between installations
as one versioned JSON file that never carries a secret. Admins and owners export it from the
Applications page or with `artisan applications:export`, and import it from an import page
(preview with new / changed / unchanged / invalid marks, an "Update existing items" switch, one
transaction, a summary toast) or with `artisan applications:import` (path or stdin, `--update`,
`--dry-run`). Every imported item goes through the same rules as the forms, nothing is ever
deleted, and an environment that needs a basic-auth password arrives with collection paused and a
"Password needed" mark until the password is typed. Older file versions are upgraded step by step;
a newer version is refused. The README gains "Moving the configuration to another panel" and the
CHANGELOG an entry. The batch ends with `composer ci:check` green and one commit on `release/1.0`.

Spec theme covered: **20. Configuration export and import**
(`docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-16-consistency-pass-design.md`, lines 411-520).

All commands run from the repo root `/home/mmarretti@enegan.locale/MyProjects/horizon-watch`
inside the Sail containers. Tasks 9.1 to 9.9 are committed together in Task 9.10 (one commit for
the batch); between tasks only the filtered tests named in each task are expected to pass.

### Assumptions about Batches 1 to 8

This part consumes, as written in their parts, these names produced earlier:

- Batch 1: `App\Enums\EnvironmentType` (`options()`, `label()`), `Environment::$type`,
  `App\Support\HorizonUrl::normalize()`, `App\Rules\OutboundUrl` inside
  `EnvironmentFormData::horizonUrlRules()` with the messages
  `'Put the credentials in the basic-auth fields, not in the Horizon URL.'` and
  `'This address points to a network the panel does not call.'`;
  `EnvironmentFormData { string $name, EnvironmentType $type, string $horizonUrl,
  int $pollIntervalSeconds, ?string $basicAuthUser, ?string $basicAuthPassword,
  bool $pollingEnabled }` with `'type' => ['required', Rule::enum(EnvironmentType::class)]` in
  `rules()`, and `EnvironmentFormData::attributes()` (Batch 1 Task 1.4, extended by Batch 5 Task
  5.7: "Horizon URL", "collection interval"), which the importer passes to its validator so an
  invalid item reads like the form; `ApplicationFormData { string $name }` whose `rules()` takes no argument;
  `AddEnvironment` / `UpdateEnvironment` writing `type`; `applications.host` gone;
  `EnvPill` props `{ name: string; type: App.Enums.EnvironmentType; size?: number }`.
- Batch 3: `formatInstant(iso, locale, now?)` in `resources/js/lib/datetime.ts`.
- Batch 4: the `lang/it.json` helper of Task 4.1 (written again in Task 9.1 Step 1, because
  `/tmp` does not survive a container restart); `TeamPolicy::manageAlertRules()` unchanged.
- Batch 5: `FormErrors` props `{ errors: Array<string | null | undefined>; title?: string | null }`,
  the CSS row `.nc-actions`, `EnvironmentFormPageData::$pollInterval` (required parameter placed
  after `$applicationSlug`), the Edit environment form card `<SectionCard :title="$t('Environment')">`
  holding `<form … @submit.prevent="submit">`.
- Batch 6: `PageHeader` props `{ title: string; subtitle?: string | null; crumbs?: Crumb[] }`,
  `.nc-page` + `.nc-page-narrow`, and the guard tests of `tests/Feature/SharedPrimitivesTest.php`
  (switches are `<label class="nc-switch">` + `role="switch"`; environments are named with
  `EnvPill`).
- Batch 7: `App\Actions\Monitoring\DispatchDuePolls::TICK_SECONDS` in the poll interval rule of
  `EnvironmentFormData::rules()`.

### Decisions taken where the spec leaves a detail open

Each is restated in the task that applies it.

- Services live in `App\Configuration\`; the two Data classes the page receives live in
  `App\Data\Configuration\`, because `TypeScriptTransformerServiceProvider` only transforms
  `app/Data` and `app/Enums`.
- The panel keeps the uploaded document in the cache (default store) for 30 minutes, keyed by
  organization and user, between the preview and the import. The import plans the file again
  inside its transaction, so the result never depends on a stale preview.
- Route names avoid the JavaScript reserved words `export` and `import` (Wayfinder exports one
  function per route): `configuration.download`, `configuration.show`, `configuration.upload`,
  `configuration.discard`, `configuration.apply`.
- Export and import need one ability, `TeamPolicy::transferConfiguration`, which holds when the
  user has `ManageApplications`, `ManageCredentials` and `ManageAlertRules` (admins and owners).
- Alert rules: only stored rows are exported. An organization row fills a null field with the
  metric default and never carries `for_minutes` for a state rule (the rule form prohibits it).
  An override row carries its non-null fields; override rows whose scope matches no environment
  of the organization, and override rows that set nothing, are left out of the file. On import an
  override row replaces the stored override as a whole (a field absent from the file goes back to
  inheriting), which is what the rule form does when it saves a scope. An override row that sets
  nothing is invalid ("This rule sets nothing: give it at least one field."), because the form
  treats it as a reset, and a reset would delete.
- Rule scopes are valid when they are `organization` or the lower-case name of an environment of
  the organization or of a valid environment in the file.
- Applications match by case-insensitive name; a different spelling is the change `name` and the
  file's spelling wins when updating (the slug never changes). Two applications of the
  organization with the same case-insensitive name make the item invalid. An application may
  bring no environment at all; one that brings more than `horizon-watch.limits.wizard_environments`
  is invalid.
- A missing `type` is invalid (the form requires it); no name-based suggestion is applied.
- The stored password is dropped, and the environment paused and marked "Password needed", when
  the basic-auth user changes **or** when the address moves to another origin
  (`StoredPasswordStaysWithItsAddress` already forbids a password to follow its environment to
  another host).
- "Password needed" is derived: `basic_auth_user` set and no stored password
  (`Environment::waitsForPassword()`). The edit form refuses to turn collection on while the
  password is still missing (new rule `PasswordBeforeCollecting`), otherwise collection could be
  switched on for an environment whose every poll is bound to fail with 401 while still marked. The application and environment pages read it from the new
  `EnvironmentData::$passwordNeeded`; the Edit environment form derives it from the
  `environment.basicAuthUser` and `hasPassword` props it already has (no new form page prop).
- The mark reads "Password needed" in English and "Password da inserire" in Italian (owner
  decision); the Italian sentence of the import page names it the same way.
- The summary's "skipped" counts the unchanged items plus the changed items left as they are.
- Changed fields are shown with the file's own keys (`horizon_url`, `poll_interval_seconds`, …):
  they are the words the admin reads when fixing the file, so they need no translation.
- The exported `horizon_url` is normalised with `HorizonUrl::normalize` after credentials are
  stripped, so a legacy URL exports in its saved form.
- The round-trip test compares the two exports with one expected difference: environments with a
  `basic_auth_user` come back with `polling_enabled: false` (the password-needed pause).
- Command-line output that is not a translated message stays plain English, like the existing
  `users:*` commands; the import summary reuses the translated toast message.

### Task 9.1: File format, reader and format upgraders

Decision: a UTF-8 byte order mark in front of the file is ignored (editors add it); `alert_rules`
may be missing and then reads as no rules; `applications` is required.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the `lang/it.json` helper into the container** (same helper as Task 4.1)

```bash
docker compose exec -T -u sail laravel.test bash -lc 'cat > /tmp/it-keys.php' <<'PHP'
<?php
[, $path, $changes] = $argv;
$keys = json_decode(file_get_contents($path), true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
$changes = json_decode($changes, true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
foreach ($changes['remove'] as $key) {
    if (! array_key_exists($key, $keys)) {
        fwrite(STDERR, "missing key: {$key}\n");
        exit(1);
    }
    unset($keys[$key]);
}
foreach ($changes['add'] as $key => $italian) {
    if (array_key_exists($key, $keys) && $keys[$key] !== $italian) {
        fwrite(STDERR, "key already present: {$key}\n");
        exit(1);
    }
    $keys[$key] = $italian;
}
ksort($keys, SORT_STRING);
file_put_contents($path, json_encode($keys, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES)."\n");
echo 'lang/it.json: '.count($changes['remove']).' removed, '.count($changes['add'])." added\n";
PHP
```

```php
<?php

namespace Tests\Support;

use App\Configuration\ConfigurationDocument;
use App\Configuration\ConfigurationReader;

final class ConfigurationFiles
{
    /**
     * @param  array<int, array<string, mixed>>  $applications
     * @param  array<int, array<string, mixed>>  $alertRules
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public static function document(array $applications = [], array $alertRules = [], int $version = 1): array
    {
        return [
            'format' => 'horizon-watch.config',
            'version' => $version,
            'exported_at' => '2026-10-16T09:00:00Z',
            'app_version' => '1.0.0',
            'organization' => 'Example Organization',
            'applications' => $applications,
            'alert_rules' => $alertRules,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public static function environment(array $overrides = []): array
    {
        return [
            'name' => 'production',
            'type' => 'production',
            'horizon_url' => 'https://shop.example.com/horizon',
            'basic_auth_user' => null,
            'poll_interval_seconds' => 60,
            'polling_enabled' => true,
            ...$overrides,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $document
     */
    public static function read(array $document): ConfigurationDocument
    {
        return app(ConfigurationReader::class)->read(json_encode($document, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));
    }
}
```

```php
    $step = fn (string $mark): FormatUpgrade => new class($mark) implements FormatUpgrade
    {
        public function __construct(private string $mark) {}

        public function upgrade(array $document): array
        {
            $document['steps'][] = $this->mark.' from '.$document['version'];

            return $document;
        }
    };

    $reader = new ConfigurationReader(currentVersion: 3, upgrades: [1 => $step('first'), 2 => $step('second')]);

    $document = $reader->read(json_encode(ConfigurationFiles::document(), JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));

    expect($document->sourceVersion)->toBe(1)
        ->and($document->data['version'])->toBe(3)
        ->and($document->data['steps'])->toBe(['first from 1', 'second from 2']);
});

    expect(ConfigurationDocument::fromArray($document->toArray()))->toEqual($document)
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Configuration;

final readonly class ConfigurationDocument
{
    /**
     * @param  array<array-key, mixed>  $data  the document, upgraded to the current format version
     */
    public function __construct(
        public array $data,
        public int $sourceVersion,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @return array<int, mixed>
     */
    public function applications(): array
    {
        return $this->list('applications');
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, mixed>
     */
    public function alertRules(): array
    {
        return $this->list('alert_rules');
    }

    public function organization(): ?string
    {
        return $this->text('organization');
    }

    public function exportedAt(): ?string
    {
        return $this->text('exported_at');
    }

    public function appVersion(): ?string
    {
        return $this->text('app_version');
    }

    /**
     * @return array{data: array<array-key, mixed>, sourceVersion: int}
     */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return ['data' => $this->data, 'sourceVersion' => $this->sourceVersion];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<array-key, mixed>  $stored
     */
    public static function fromArray(array $stored): ?self
    {
        $data = $stored['data'] ?? null;
        $version = $stored['sourceVersion'] ?? null;

        return is_array($data) && is_int($version) ? new self($data, $version) : null;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, mixed>
     */
    private function list(string $key): array
    {
        $value = $this->data[$key] ?? [];

        return is_array($value) ? array_values($value) : [];
    }

    private function text(string $key): ?string
    {
        $value = $this->data[$key] ?? null;

        return is_string($value) ? $value : null;
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 9: Create `app/Configuration/ConfigurationReader.php`**

```php
<?php

namespace App\Configuration;

use JsonException;
use LogicException;

final readonly class ConfigurationReader
{
    /**
     * @param  array<int, FormatUpgrade>  $upgrades  keyed by the version each one upgrades from
     */
    public function __construct(
        private int $currentVersion = ConfigurationFormat::VERSION,
        private array $upgrades = [],
    ) {}

    /**
     * @throws InvalidConfigurationFile
     */
    public function read(string $contents): ConfigurationDocument
    {
        if (strlen($contents) > ConfigurationFormat::MAX_BYTES) {
            throw InvalidConfigurationFile::tooLarge();
        }

        if (str_starts_with($contents, "\u{FEFF}")) {
            $contents = substr($contents, 3);
        }

        try {
            $data = json_decode($contents, true, 64, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        } catch (JsonException) {
            throw InvalidConfigurationFile::malformed();
        }

        if (! is_array($data) || array_is_list($data) || ($data['format'] ?? null) !== ConfigurationFormat::FORMAT) {
            throw InvalidConfigurationFile::wrongFormat();
        }

        $version = $data['version'] ?? null;

        if (! is_int($version) || $version < 1) {
            throw InvalidConfigurationFile::noVersion();
        }

        if ($version > $this->currentVersion) {
            throw InvalidConfigurationFile::newer();
        }

        $sourceVersion = $version;

        while ($version < $this->currentVersion) {
            $upgrade = $this->upgrades[$version]
                ?? throw new LogicException("No upgrade is registered for configuration format version {$version}.");

            $data = $upgrade->upgrade($data);
            $data['version'] = ++$version;
        }

        $data['alert_rules'] ??= [];

        if (! self::isList($data['applications'] ?? null) || ! self::isList($data['alert_rules'])) {
            throw InvalidConfigurationFile::wrongShape();
        }

        return new ConfigurationDocument($data, $sourceVersion);
    }

    private static function isList(mixed $value): bool
    {
        return is_array($value) && array_is_list($value);
    }
}
```

### Task 9.2: Exporter

Decisions: applications are ordered by lower-case name then id, environments by id (creation
order), alert rules organization first, then by scope, then in `AlertRuleMetric` case order. The
file is pretty-printed with unescaped slashes and Unicode and ends with a newline. Override rows of
missing environments and override rows that set nothing are left out. Organization rows fill a null
field with the metric default and carry no `for_minutes` for a state rule. `TeamFactory::definition()`
sets `slug` from its own random name (`'Organization ####'`), so overriding only `name` does not change
the slug: every test that checks the file name or uses the slug creates the team with
`['name' => 'Example Organization', 'slug' => 'example-organization']`.

**Files:**

- Create: `app/Configuration/ConfigurationExporter.php`
- Test: `tests/Feature/Configuration/ConfigurationExporterTest.php`

**Interfaces:**

- Consumes: `ConfigurationFormat` (9.1), `HorizonUrl::normalize()` and `Environment::$type`
  (Batch 1), `EnvironmentFormData::withoutUserinfo()`, `EffectiveRule::default()`,
  `App\Support\Version::current()`.
- Produces: `ConfigurationExporter::export(Team): array<string, mixed>`,
  `::toJson(array): string`, `::fileName(Team): string`.

- [ ] **Step 3: Create `app/Configuration/ConfigurationExporter.php`**

```php
<?php

namespace App\Configuration;

use App\Alerts\EffectiveRule;
use App\Data\Applications\EnvironmentFormData;
use App\Enums\AlertRuleMetric;
use App\Models\AlertRule;
use App\Models\Application;
use App\Models\Environment;
use App\Models\Team;
use App\Support\HorizonUrl;
use App\Support\Version;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

final class ConfigurationExporter
{
    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function export(Team $team): array
    {
        return [
            'format' => ConfigurationFormat::FORMAT,
            'version' => ConfigurationFormat::VERSION,
            'exported_at' => CarbonImmutable::now()->utc()->format('Y-m-d\TH:i:s\Z'),
            'app_version' => Version::current(),
            'organization' => $team->name,
            'applications' => $this->applications($team),
            'alert_rules' => $this->alertRules($team),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $document
     */
    public function toJson(array $document): string
    {
        return json_encode($document, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR)."\n";
    }

    public function fileName(Team $team): string
    {
        return 'horizon-watch-'.$team->slug.'-'.CarbonImmutable::now()->format('Y-m-d').'.json';
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    private function applications(Team $team): array
    {
        return $team->applications()
            ->with(['environments' => fn ($query) => $query->orderBy('id')])
            ->orderByRaw('lower(name)')
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->get()
            ->map(fn (Application $application) => [
                'name' => $application->name,
                'environments' => $application->environments
                    ->map(fn (Environment $environment) => [
                        'name' => $environment->name,
                        'type' => $environment->type->value,
                        'horizon_url' => HorizonUrl::normalize(EnvironmentFormData::withoutUserinfo($environment->horizon_url)),
                        'basic_auth_user' => $environment->basic_auth_user,
                        'poll_interval_seconds' => $environment->poll_interval_seconds,
                        'polling_enabled' => $environment->polling_enabled,
                    ])
                    ->values()
                    ->all(),
            ])
            ->values()
            ->all();
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    private function alertRules(Team $team): array
    {
        $scopes = $team->environments()->pluck('environments.name')
            ->map(fn (mixed $name) => Str::lower((string) $name))
            ->unique()
            ->all();
        $order = array_flip(array_map(fn (AlertRuleMetric $metric) => $metric->value, AlertRuleMetric::cases()));

        return $team->alertRules()->get()
            ->filter(fn (AlertRule $rule) => $rule->scope === AlertRule::ORGANIZATION || in_array($rule->scope, $scopes, true))
            ->sortBy(fn (AlertRule $rule) => sprintf(
                '%d|%s|%02d',
                $rule->scope === AlertRule::ORGANIZATION ? 0 : 1,
                $rule->scope,
                $order[$rule->metric->value],
            ))
            ->map(fn (AlertRule $rule) => $this->rule($rule))
            ->filter(fn (array $row) => count($row) > 2)
            ->values()
            ->all();
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function rule(AlertRule $rule): array
    {
        $metric = $rule->metric;
        $fields = [
            'threshold' => $rule->threshold === null ? null : (int) $rule->threshold,
            'severity' => $rule->severity?->value,
            'notify_by_email' => $rule->notify_email,
            'enabled' => $rule->enabled,
            'for_minutes' => $metric->isStateRule() ? null : $rule->for_minutes,
        ];

        if ($rule->scope === AlertRule::ORGANIZATION) {
            $default = EffectiveRule::default($metric);

            $fields = [
                'threshold' => $fields['threshold'] ?? (int) $default->threshold,
                'severity' => $fields['severity'] ?? $default->severity->value,
                'notify_by_email' => $fields['notify_by_email'] ?? $default->notifyByEmail,
                'enabled' => $fields['enabled'] ?? $default->enabled,
                'for_minutes' => $metric->isStateRule() ? null : ($fields['for_minutes'] ?? $default->forMinutes),
            ];
        }

        return [
            'scope' => $rule->scope,
            'metric' => $metric->value,
            ...array_filter($fields, fn (mixed $value) => $value !== null),
        ];
    }
}
```

### Task 9.3: One set of environment rules for the forms and the import; no collection without a password

Decisions: the import validates an environment with the form's rules minus the uniqueness check
(the import matches by name, so a same-named environment is the item itself) and minus the
password (a file never carries one). When an environment has a basic-auth user but no stored
password, the edit form requires the password before collection can be turned on. This also
refuses, with collection on, an edit that adds a username to an environment without a stored
password (until now the update accepted it and the environment polled without a password); with
collection off the edit still goes through.

  `reservedNameRule()`, `passwordRequiredWithUsernameRules()`; new static methods)
- Modify: `app/Models/Environment.php` (new method right before `getRouteKeyName()`; Batch 1
  deleted `looksLikeProduction()`)
- Create: `app/Rules/PasswordBeforeCollecting.php`
- Modify: `lang/it.json`
- Test: `tests/Feature/Configuration/EnvironmentImportRulesTest.php`
- Modify (test): `tests/Feature/Monitoring/EnvironmentCrudTest.php` (test
  `'touching credentials requires the manage-credentials permission in addition to update'`)

```php
use App\Models\Environment;
use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;

function importRuleErrors(array $overrides = []): array
{
    $payload = [
        'name' => 'production',
        'type' => 'production',
        'horizonUrl' => 'https://shop.example.com/horizon',
        'basicAuthUser' => 'ops',
        'pollIntervalSeconds' => 60,
        'pollingEnabled' => true,
        ...$overrides,
    ];

    return Validator::make($payload, EnvironmentFormData::importRules())->errors()->all();
}

test('the import rules accept a basic-auth user without a password and an existing name', function () {
    $application = Application::factory()->create();
    Environment::factory()->for($application)->create(['name' => 'production']);

    expect(importRuleErrors())->toBe([]);
});

test('the import rules are the rules of the form', function (array $overrides, string $message) {
    expect(importRuleErrors($overrides))->toContain($message);
})->with([
    'reserved name' => [['name' => 'organization'], 'This name is reserved for the organization-wide alert rules.'],
    'unknown type' => [['type' => 'worker'], 'The selected type is invalid.'],
    'credentials in the url' => [['horizonUrl' => 'https://ops:secret@shop.example.com/horizon'], 'Put the credentials in the basic-auth fields, not in the Horizon URL.'],
    'a network the panel never calls' => [['horizonUrl' => 'http://169.254.169.254/horizon'], 'This address points to a network the panel does not call.'],
]);

test('the import rules refuse a name in capitals, a missing type and an interval out of bounds', function (array $overrides) {
    expect(importRuleErrors($overrides))->toHaveCount(1);
})->with([
    'capitals' => [['name' => 'Production']],
    'no type' => [['type' => null]],
    'off the tick' => [['pollIntervalSeconds' => 20]],
    'over the maximum' => [['pollIntervalSeconds' => 600]],
]);

test('an environment that waits for its password cannot turn collection on without it', function () {
    $team = Team::factory()->create();
    $admin = User::factory()->create();
    $team->members()->attach($admin, ['role' => TeamRole::Admin->value]);
    $environment = Environment::factory()->for(Application::factory()->for($team))->create([
        'name' => 'production',
        'type' => EnvironmentType::Production,
        'horizon_url' => 'https://shop.example.com/horizon',
        'basic_auth_user' => 'ops',
        'basic_auth_password' => null,
        'poll_interval_seconds' => 60,
        'polling_enabled' => false,
    ]);
    $update = route('environments.update', ['current_team' => $team->slug, 'environment' => $environment->slug]);
    $payload = [
        'name' => 'production',
        'type' => 'production',
        'horizonUrl' => 'https://shop.example.com/horizon',
        'basicAuthUser' => 'ops',
        'basicAuthPassword' => null,
        'pollIntervalSeconds' => 60,
        'pollingEnabled' => true,
    ];

    expect($environment->waitsForPassword())->toBeTrue();

    $this->actingAs($admin)->patch($update, $payload)
        ->assertSessionHasErrors(['basicAuthPassword' => 'Enter the basic-auth password before turning collection on.']);

    $this->actingAs($admin)->patch($update, [...$payload, 'pollingEnabled' => false, 'pollIntervalSeconds' => 120])
        ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

    $this->actingAs($admin)->patch($update, [...$payload, 'basicAuthPassword' => 'typed-at-last'])
        ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

    $environment->refresh();

    expect($environment->basic_auth_password)->toBe('typed-at-last')
        ->and($environment->polling_enabled)->toBeTrue()
        ->and($environment->waitsForPassword())->toBeFalse();
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Create `app/Rules/PasswordBeforeCollecting.php`**

```php
<?php

namespace App\Rules;

use App\Models\Environment;
use Closure;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\ValidationRule;
use Illuminate\Translation\PotentiallyTranslatedString;

class PasswordBeforeCollecting implements ValidationRule
{
    public bool $implicit = true;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly ?Environment $stored,
        private readonly mixed $username,
        private readonly mixed $pollingEnabled,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  Closure(string, ?string=): PotentiallyTranslatedString  $fail
     */
    public function validate(string $attribute, mixed $value, Closure $fail): void
    {
        if ($this->stored === null
            || filled($value)
            || blank($this->username)
            || StoredPasswordStaysWithItsAddress::hasStoredPassword($this->stored)
            || filter_var($this->pollingEnabled, FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN, FILTER_NULL_ON_FAILURE) === false) {
            return;
        }

        $fail(__('Enter the basic-auth password before turning collection on.'));
    }
}
```

```php
    /**
     * A basic-auth user without a stored password: the environment waits for someone to type it
     * (an import never brings one), and its collection stays paused until then.
     */
    public function waitsForPassword(): bool
    {
        return $this->basic_auth_user !== null
            && ($this->getAttributes()['basic_auth_password'] ?? null) === null;
    }
```

```php
<?php

use App\Configuration\ConfigurationExporter;
use App\Configuration\ConfigurationImporter;
use App\Configuration\ImportBlocked;
use App\Data\Configuration\ImportItemData;
use App\Enums\AlertRuleMetric;
use App\Enums\AlertSeverity;
use App\Enums\EnvironmentType;
use App\Models\AlertRule;

use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Tests\Support\ConfigurationFiles;

beforeEach(function () {
    $this->team = Team::factory()->create(['name' => 'Example Organization']);
    $this->acme = Application::factory()->for($this->team)->create(['name' => 'Acme Shop']);
    $this->production = Environment::factory()->for($this->acme)->create([
        'name' => 'production',
        'type' => EnvironmentType::Production,
        'horizon_url' => 'https://shop.example.com/horizon',
        'basic_auth_user' => 'ops',
        'basic_auth_password' => 'stored-secret',
        'poll_interval_seconds' => 60,
        'polling_enabled' => true,
    ]);
    $this->staging = Environment::factory()->for($this->acme)->create([
        'name' => 'staging',
        'type' => EnvironmentType::Staging,
        'horizon_url' => 'https://staging.shop.example.com/horizon',
        'basic_auth_user' => null,
        'basic_auth_password' => null,
        'poll_interval_seconds' => 30,
        'polling_enabled' => true,
    ]);

    $this->importer = app(ConfigurationImporter::class);

    $this->productionEntry = fn (array $overrides = []): array => ConfigurationFiles::environment([
        'basic_auth_user' => 'ops',
        ...$overrides,
    ]);
    $this->stagingEntry = fn (array $overrides = []): array => ConfigurationFiles::environment([
        'name' => 'staging',
        'type' => 'staging',
        'horizon_url' => 'https://staging.shop.example.com/horizon',
        'poll_interval_seconds' => 30,
        ...$overrides,
    ]);
    $this->preview = fn (array $document) => $this->importer->preview($this->team, ConfigurationFiles::read($document), 'shop.json');
    $this->statuses = fn (array $document): array => collect(($this->preview)($document)->items)
        ->map(fn (ImportItemData $item) => [$item->kind->value, $item->label, $item->status->value, $item->changes])
        ->all();
    $this->apply = fn (array $document, bool $update) => $this->importer->apply($this->team, ConfigurationFiles::read($document), $update);
});

test('override rows take the values of the file and the organization rows are written whole', function () {
    AlertRule::factory()->for($this->team)->create([
        'scope' => 'staging',
        'metric' => AlertRuleMetric::QueuePending,
        'threshold' => 50,
        'severity' => AlertSeverity::Critical,
        'notify_email' => null,
        'enabled' => null,
        'for_minutes' => null,
    ]);

    ($this->apply)(ConfigurationFiles::document([], [
        ['scope' => 'staging', 'metric' => 'queue.pending', 'threshold' => 80],
        ['scope' => 'organization', 'metric' => 'endpoint.unreachable', 'threshold' => 3, 'severity' => 'critical', 'notify_by_email' => false, 'enabled' => true],
    ]), true);

    $override = AlertRule::where('team_id', $this->team->id)->where('scope', 'staging')->sole();
    $organization = AlertRule::where('team_id', $this->team->id)->where('scope', 'organization')->sole();

    expect([$override->threshold, $override->severity])->toBe([80.0, null])
        ->and([$organization->metric, $organization->threshold, $organization->notify_email, $organization->for_minutes])
        ->toBe([AlertRuleMetric::EndpointUnreachable, 3.0, false, null]);
});

test('one invalid item blocks the whole import and nothing is written', function () {
    $document = ConfigurationFiles::document([
        ['name' => 'Billing', 'environments' => [ConfigurationFiles::environment(['horizon_url' => 'https://billing.example.com/horizon'])]],
        ['name' => 'Payroll', 'environments' => [ConfigurationFiles::environment(['type' => 'worker'])]],
    ]);

    expect(fn () => ($this->apply)($document, true))
        ->toThrow(ImportBlocked::class, 'Fix the invalid items in the file and upload it again.');

    expect(Application::where('team_id', $this->team->id)->pluck('name')->all())->toBe(['Acme Shop']);
});

test('items missing from the file stay as they are', function () {
    AlertRule::factory()->for($this->team)->inheriting()->create(['scope' => 'staging', 'metric' => AlertRuleMetric::QueuePending, 'threshold' => 50]);

    ($this->apply)(ConfigurationFiles::document([['name' => 'Billing', 'environments' => []]]), true);

    expect($this->acme->environments()->count())->toBe(2)
        ->and(AlertRule::where('team_id', $this->team->id)->count())->toBe(1)
        ->and(Application::where('team_id', $this->team->id)->orderBy('id')->pluck('name')->all())->toBe(['Acme Shop', 'Billing']);
});

test('export, import into an empty organization and export again give the same file', function () {
    $this->travelTo(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-16 09:00:00'));
    AlertRule::factory()->for($this->team)->create([
        'scope' => AlertRule::ORGANIZATION,
        'metric' => AlertRuleMetric::QueuePending,
        'threshold' => 2000,
        'severity' => AlertSeverity::Warning,
        'notify_email' => true,
        'enabled' => true,
        'for_minutes' => 5,
    ]);
    AlertRule::factory()->for($this->team)->inheriting()->create(['scope' => 'production', 'metric' => AlertRuleMetric::QueueMaxWait, 'threshold' => 90]);

    $exporter = app(ConfigurationExporter::class);
    $first = $exporter->export($this->team);
    $target = Team::factory()->create(['name' => 'Example Organization']);

    $summary = $this->importer->apply($target, ConfigurationFiles::read($first), false);

    $expected = $first;
    $expected['applications'][0]['environments'][0]['polling_enabled'] = false;

    expect($summary->created)->toBe(5)
        ->and($summary->passwordNeeded)->toBe(1)
        ->and($exporter->export($target))->toBe($expected);
});
```

(The round trip's one expected difference is the password-needed pause of `production`, the
only environment with a `basic_auth_user`. The untidy-address case pins theme 20's "same rules
as the forms": `planEnvironment()` stores `HorizonUrl::normalize($url)` (capitals in scheme and
host lowered, trailing slash and `/api…` suffix cut) and compares it with the stored address
normalised the same way, so pasting the address again in another spelling is never a change.)

```php
<?php

namespace App\Configuration;

final readonly class ImportSummary
{
    public function __construct(
        public int $created,
        public int $updated,
        public int $skipped,
        public int $passwordNeeded,
    ) {}

    public function message(): string
    {
        $message = __('Configuration imported: :created created, :updated updated, :skipped left as they were.', [
            'created' => $this->created,
            'updated' => $this->updated,
            'skipped' => $this->skipped,
        ]);

        if ($this->passwordNeeded > 0) {
            $message .= ' '.trans_choice(
                ':count environment waits for its basic-auth password.|:count environments wait for their basic-auth password.',
                $this->passwordNeeded,
                ['count' => $this->passwordNeeded],
            );
        }

        return $message;
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: Create `app/Configuration/ConfigurationImporter.php`**

`planEnvironment()` builds `EnvironmentFormData` with the constructor Batch 1 wrote (`name`,
`type`, `horizonUrl`, `pollIntervalSeconds`, `basicAuthUser`, `basicAuthPassword`,
`pollingEnabled`); Batches 5 and 7 change only its `rules()`, not its constructor.

```php
<?php

namespace App\Configuration;

use App\Actions\Alerts\UpdateAlertRules;
use App\Actions\Environments\AddEnvironment;
use App\Actions\Environments\UpdateEnvironment;
use App\Data\Alerts\AlertRuleInputData;
use App\Data\Alerts\AlertRulesInputData;
use App\Data\Applications\ApplicationFormData;
use App\Data\Applications\EnvironmentFormData;
use App\Data\Configuration\ImportItemData;
use App\Data\Configuration\ImportPreviewData;
use App\Enums\AlertRuleMetric;
use App\Enums\EnvironmentType;
use App\Enums\ImportItemKind;
use App\Enums\ImportItemStatus;
use App\Models\AlertRule;
use App\Models\Application;
use App\Models\Environment;
use App\Models\Team;
use App\Rules\StoredPasswordStaysWithItsAddress;
use App\Support\HorizonUrl;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use LogicException;

final class ConfigurationImporter
{
    private const string NO_NAME = '—';

    public function __construct(
        private AddEnvironment $addEnvironment,
        private UpdateEnvironment $updateEnvironment,
        private UpdateAlertRules $updateAlertRules,
    ) {}

    public function preview(Team $team, ConfigurationDocument $document, string $fileName): ImportPreviewData
    {
        $items = array_map(fn (PlannedItem $planned) => $planned->item, $this->plan($team, $document));

        return new ImportPreviewData(
            fileName: $fileName,
            organization: $document->organization(),
            exportedAt: $document->exportedAt(),
            appVersion: $document->appVersion(),
            version: $document->sourceVersion,
            items: $items,
            blocked: self::blocks($items),
        );
    }

    /**
     * @throws ImportBlocked
     */
    public function apply(Team $team, ConfigurationDocument $document, bool $update): ImportSummary
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($team, $document, $update) {
            $plan = $this->plan($team, $document);

            if (self::blocks(array_map(fn (PlannedItem $planned) => $planned->item, $plan))) {
                throw new ImportBlocked;
            }

            $created = $updated = $skipped = $passwordNeeded = 0;

            /** @var array<string, Application> $applications */
            $applications = [];

            foreach ($plan as $planned) {
                $status = $planned->item->status;
                $writes = $status === ImportItemStatus::New || ($status === ImportItemStatus::Changed && $update);

                if ($planned->item->kind === ImportItemKind::Application) {
                    $applications[$planned->key] = $writes
                        ? $this->writeApplication($team, $planned)
                        : ($planned->application ?? throw new LogicException('A skipped application exists.'));
                } elseif ($writes && $planned->item->kind === ImportItemKind::Environment) {
                    $this->writeEnvironment(
                        $applications[$planned->key] ?? throw new LogicException('An environment follows its application.'),
                        $planned,
                    );
                } elseif ($writes) {
                    $this->updateAlertRules->handle($team, $planned->key, new AlertRulesInputData([
                        $planned->rule ?? throw new LogicException('A rule item carries its rule.'),
                    ]));
                }

                if (! $writes) {
                    $skipped++;

                    continue;
                }

                if ($status === ImportItemStatus::New) {
                    $created++;
                } else {
                    $updated++;
                }

                if ($planned->item->passwordNeeded) {
                    $passwordNeeded++;
                }
            }

            return new ImportSummary($created, $updated, $skipped, $passwordNeeded);
        });
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, PlannedItem>
     */
    private function plan(Team $team, ConfigurationDocument $document): array
    {
        $stored = $team->applications()->with('environments')->orderBy('id')->get()
            ->groupBy(fn (Application $application) => Str::lower($application->name));
        $cap = config()->integer('horizon-watch.limits.wizard_environments');

        $plan = [];
        $seenApplications = [];

        foreach ($document->applications() as $entry) {
            $entry = is_array($entry) ? $entry : [];
            $name = is_string($entry['name'] ?? null) ? trim($entry['name']) : null;
            $key = Str::lower($name ?? '');
            /** @var Collection<int, Application> $matches */
            $matches = $name === null ? collect() : $stored->get($key, collect());
            $existing = $matches->first();
            $environments = $entry['environments'] ?? [];

            $errors = Validator::make(['name' => $name], ['name' => ApplicationFormData::rules()['name']])->errors()->all();

            if ($name !== null && in_array($key, $seenApplications, true)) {
                $errors[] = __('This file lists the application :name twice.', ['name' => $name]);
            }

            if ($matches->count() > 1) {
                $errors[] = __('Two applications of this organization are named :name: rename one of them first.', ['name' => $name]);
            }

            if (! is_array($environments) || ! array_is_list($environments)) {
                $errors[] = __('This application lists its environments in the wrong shape.');
                $environments = [];
            } elseif (count($environments) > $cap) {
                $errors[] = __('An application can bring at most :max environments in one import.', ['max' => $cap]);
            }

            if ($name !== null) {
                $seenApplications[] = $key;
            }

            $plan[] = new PlannedItem(
                item: $this->item(
                    kind: ImportItemKind::Application,
                    label: $name ?? self::NO_NAME,
                    errors: $errors,
                    existing: $existing !== null,
                    changes: $existing !== null && $existing->name !== $name ? ['name'] : [],
                ),
                key: $key,
                name: $name,
                application: $existing,
            );

            $seenEnvironments = [];

            foreach ($environments as $environment) {
                $plan[] = $this->planEnvironment(
                    is_array($environment) ? $environment : [],
                    $key,
                    $name ?? self::NO_NAME,
                    $existing,
                    $seenEnvironments,
                );
            }
        }

        $scopes = array_values(array_unique([
            ...$team->environments()->pluck('environments.name')->map(fn (mixed $name) => Str::lower((string) $name))->all(),
            ...collect($plan)
                ->filter(fn (PlannedItem $planned) => $planned->item->kind === ImportItemKind::Environment
                    && $planned->item->status !== ImportItemStatus::Invalid)
                ->map(fn (PlannedItem $planned) => Str::lower($planned->item->label))
                ->all(),
        ]));
        $rules = $team->alertRules()->get()->keyBy(fn (AlertRule $rule) => $rule->scope.'|'.$rule->metric->value);
        $seenRules = [];

        foreach ($document->alertRules() as $entry) {
            $plan[] = $this->planRule(is_array($entry) ? $entry : [], $scopes, $rules, $seenRules);
        }

        return $plan;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<array-key, mixed>  $entry
     * @param  array<int, string>  $seen
     */
    private function planEnvironment(array $entry, string $applicationKey, string $applicationName, ?Application $application, array &$seen): PlannedItem
    {
        $url = $entry['horizon_url'] ?? null;
        $user = $entry['basic_auth_user'] ?? null;
        $payload = [
            'name' => $entry['name'] ?? null,
            'type' => $entry['type'] ?? null,
            'horizonUrl' => is_string($url) ? HorizonUrl::normalize($url) : $url,
            'basicAuthUser' => is_string($user) && trim($user) === '' ? null : $user,
            'pollIntervalSeconds' => $entry['poll_interval_seconds'] ?? config()->integer('horizon-watch.readings.poll_interval_seconds.default'),
            'pollingEnabled' => $entry['polling_enabled'] ?? true,
        ];
        $name = is_string($payload['name']) ? $payload['name'] : null;

        $errors = Validator::make($payload, EnvironmentFormData::importRules(), [], EnvironmentFormData::attributes())->errors()->all();

        if ($name !== null && in_array($name, $seen, true)) {
            $errors[] = __('This file lists the environment :name twice in this application.', ['name' => $name]);
        }

        if ($name !== null) {
            $seen[] = $name;
        }

        if ($errors !== []) {
            return new PlannedItem(
                item: $this->item(ImportItemKind::Environment, $name ?? self::NO_NAME, $errors, false, [], application: $applicationName),
                key: $applicationKey,
            );
        }

        $type = EnvironmentType::from((string) $payload['type']);
        $data = new EnvironmentFormData(
            name: (string) $name,
            type: $type,
            horizonUrl: (string) $payload['horizonUrl'],
            pollIntervalSeconds: (int) $payload['pollIntervalSeconds'],
            basicAuthUser: is_string($payload['basicAuthUser']) ? $payload['basicAuthUser'] : null,
            basicAuthPassword: null,
            pollingEnabled: filter_var($payload['pollingEnabled'], FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN),
        );

        /** @var Environment|null $stored */
        $stored = $application?->environments->firstWhere('name', $name);

        $keepsPassword = $stored !== null
            && $data->basicAuthUser !== null
            && $data->basicAuthUser === $stored->basic_auth_user
            && StoredPasswordStaysWithItsAddress::hasStoredPassword($stored)
            && EnvironmentFormData::sameAddress($data->horizonUrl, $stored->horizon_url);
        $passwordNeeded = $data->basicAuthUser !== null && ! $keepsPassword;

        if ($passwordNeeded) {
            $data->pollingEnabled = false;
        }

        $changes = $stored === null ? [] : array_keys(array_filter([
            'type' => $stored->type !== $data->type,
            'horizon_url' => HorizonUrl::normalize(EnvironmentFormData::withoutUserinfo($stored->horizon_url)) !== $data->horizonUrl,
            'basic_auth_user' => $stored->basic_auth_user !== $data->basicAuthUser,
            'poll_interval_seconds' => $stored->poll_interval_seconds !== $data->pollIntervalSeconds,
            'polling_enabled' => $stored->polling_enabled !== $data->pollingEnabled,
        ]));

        return new PlannedItem(
            item: $this->item(
                kind: ImportItemKind::Environment,
                label: (string) $name,
                errors: [],
                existing: $stored !== null,
                changes: $changes,
                application: $applicationName,
                type: $type,
                passwordNeeded: $passwordNeeded,
            ),
            key: $applicationKey,
            environment: $stored,
            environmentData: $data,
        );
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<array-key, mixed>  $entry
     * @param  array<int, string>  $scopes
     * @param  Collection<string, AlertRule>  $stored
     * @param  array<int, string>  $seen
     */
    private function planRule(array $entry, array $scopes, Collection $stored, array &$seen): PlannedItem
    {
        $scope = is_string($entry['scope'] ?? null) ? Str::lower(trim($entry['scope'])) : null;
        $metricValue = is_string($entry['metric'] ?? null) ? $entry['metric'] : null;
        $metric = $metricValue === null ? null : AlertRuleMetric::tryFrom($metricValue);
        $organization = $scope === AlertRule::ORGANIZATION;

        $errors = Validator::make(['scope' => $scope], ['scope' => ['required', 'string', 'max:60']])->errors()->all();
        $rule = null;

        try {
            $rule = AlertRuleInputData::validateAndCreate([
                AlertRulesInputData::SCOPE => $scope ?? AlertRule::ORGANIZATION,
                'metric' => $entry['metric'] ?? null,
                'threshold' => $entry['threshold'] ?? null,
                'severity' => $entry['severity'] ?? null,
                'notifyByEmail' => $entry['notify_by_email'] ?? null,
                'enabled' => $entry['enabled'] ?? null,
                'forMinutes' => $entry['for_minutes'] ?? null,
            ]);
        } catch (ValidationException $exception) {
            $errors = [...$errors, ...$exception->validator->errors()->all()];
        }

        if ($scope !== null && ! $organization && ! in_array($scope, $scopes, true)) {
            $errors[] = __('No environment is named :scope, in this organization or in the file.', ['scope' => $scope]);
        }

        if ($rule !== null && ! $organization && $rule->isEmpty()) {
            $errors[] = __('This rule sets nothing: give it at least one field.');
        }

        $ruleKey = ($scope ?? '').'|'.($metricValue ?? '');

        if ($scope !== null && $metric !== null && in_array($ruleKey, $seen, true)) {
            $errors[] = __('This file lists this rule twice for :scope.', ['scope' => $scope]);
        }

        $seen[] = $ruleKey;
        $existing = $stored->get($ruleKey);

        $changes = $rule === null || $existing === null ? [] : array_keys(array_filter([
            'threshold' => $existing->threshold !== ($rule->threshold === null ? null : (float) $rule->threshold),
            'severity' => $existing->severity !== $rule->severity,
            'notify_by_email' => $existing->notify_email !== $rule->notifyByEmail,
            'enabled' => $existing->enabled !== $rule->enabled,
            'for_minutes' => ! $rule->metric->isStateRule() && $existing->for_minutes !== $rule->forMinutes,
        ]));

        return new PlannedItem(
            item: $this->item(
                kind: ImportItemKind::AlertRule,
                label: ($scope ?? self::NO_NAME).' / '.($metricValue ?? self::NO_NAME),
                errors: $errors,
                existing: $existing !== null,
                changes: $changes,
                scope: $scope,
                metric: $metric,
            ),
            key: $scope ?? AlertRule::ORGANIZATION,
            rule: $rule,
        );
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, string>  $errors
     * @param  array<int, string>  $changes
     */
    private function item(
        ImportItemKind $kind,
        string $label,
        array $errors,
        bool $existing,
        array $changes,
        ?string $application = null,
        ?string $scope = null,
        ?AlertRuleMetric $metric = null,
        ?EnvironmentType $type = null,
        bool $passwordNeeded = false,
    ): ImportItemData {
        $errors = array_values(array_unique($errors));

        return new ImportItemData(
            kind: $kind,
            label: $label,
            application: $application,
            scope: $scope,
            metric: $metric,
            type: $type,
            status: match (true) {
                $errors !== [] => ImportItemStatus::Invalid,
                ! $existing => ImportItemStatus::New,
                $changes !== [] => ImportItemStatus::Changed,
                default => ImportItemStatus::Unchanged,
            },
            changes: $errors === [] ? $changes : [],
            errors: $errors,
            passwordNeeded: $errors === [] && $passwordNeeded,
        );
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, ImportItemData>  $items
     */
    private static function blocks(array $items): bool
    {
        return collect($items)->contains(fn (ImportItemData $item) => $item->status === ImportItemStatus::Invalid);
    }

    private function writeApplication(Team $team, PlannedItem $planned): Application
    {
        $name = $planned->name ?? throw new LogicException('An application item carries its name.');

        if ($planned->application === null) {
            return $team->applications()->create(['name' => $name]);
        }

        $planned->application->update(['name' => $name]);

        return $planned->application;
    }

    private function writeEnvironment(Application $application, PlannedItem $planned): void
    {
        $data = $planned->environmentData ?? throw new LogicException('An environment item carries its data.');
        $environment = $planned->environment;

        if ($environment === null) {
            $this->addEnvironment->handle($application, $data);

            return;
        }

        if ($planned->item->passwordNeeded && StoredPasswordStaysWithItsAddress::hasStoredPassword($environment)) {
            $environment->forceFill(['basic_auth_password' => null])->save();
        }

        $this->updateEnvironment->handle($environment, $data);
    }
}
```

(`UpdateEnvironment` keeps the stored password whenever the user is set and no new password
comes, and its "password cannot follow" guard only fires while a password is stored, which
`writeEnvironment()` clears first in that case. A new environment gets no password from
`AddEnvironment` because `basicAuthPassword` is null.)

- [ ] **Step 3: Create `resources/js/lib/configuration.ts`**

```ts
import { trans } from 'laravel-vue-i18n';
import { ruleLabel } from '@/lib/alertRules';

type ImportItem = App.Data.Configuration.ImportItemData;

export type ImportTotals = {
    create: number;
    update: number;
    leave: number;
    invalid: number;
};

export function importTotals(
    items: ImportItem[],
    update: boolean,
): ImportTotals {
    const totals: ImportTotals = { create: 0, update: 0, leave: 0, invalid: 0 };

    for (const item of items) {
        switch (item.status) {
            case 'new':
                totals.create++;
                break;
            case 'changed':
                if (update) {
                    totals.update++;
                } else {
                    totals.leave++;
                }
                break;
            case 'unchanged':
                totals.leave++;
                break;
            case 'invalid':
                totals.invalid++;
                break;
        }
    }

    return totals;
}

export function importStatusLabel(status: App.Enums.ImportItemStatus): string {
    switch (status) {
        case 'new':
            return trans('New');
        case 'changed':
            return trans('Changed');
        case 'unchanged':
            return trans('Unchanged');
        case 'invalid':
            return trans('Invalid');
    }
}

export function importStatusClass(status: App.Enums.ImportItemStatus): string {
    switch (status) {
        case 'new':
            return 'nc-tag-accent';
        case 'changed':
            return 'nc-tag-outline';
        case 'unchanged':
            return 'nc-tag-neutral';
        case 'invalid':
            return 'nc-tone-down is-invalid';
    }
}

export function importOutcome(item: ImportItem, update: boolean): string | null {
    if (item.status !== 'changed') {
        return null;
    }

    return update ? trans('will be updated') : trans('left as it is');
}

export function importItemLabel(item: ImportItem): string {
    switch (item.kind) {
        case 'application':
            return item.label;
        case 'environment':
            return `${item.application ?? '—'} / ${item.label}`;
        case 'alert_rule': {
            if (item.metric === null || item.scope === null) {
                return item.label;
            }

            const scope =
                item.scope === 'organization'
                    ? trans('Organization')
                    : item.scope;

            return `${scope} / ${ruleLabel(item.metric)}`;
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Create `app/Configuration/PendingImport.php`**

```php
<?php

namespace App\Configuration;

use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Cache\Repository;

/**
 * The file an admin uploaded and is looking at, kept between the preview and the import.
 */
final readonly class PendingImport
{
    private const int MINUTES = 30;

    public function __construct(private Repository $cache) {}

    public function put(Team $team, User $user, ConfigurationDocument $document, string $fileName): void
    {
        $this->cache->put(
            $this->key($team, $user),
            ['document' => $document->toArray(), 'fileName' => $fileName],
            now()->addMinutes(self::MINUTES),
        );
    }

    /**
     * @return array{document: ConfigurationDocument, fileName: string}|null
     */
    public function get(Team $team, User $user): ?array
    {
        $stored = $this->cache->get($this->key($team, $user));

        if (! is_array($stored) || ! is_array($stored['document'] ?? null) || ! is_string($stored['fileName'] ?? null)) {
            return null;
        }

        $document = ConfigurationDocument::fromArray($stored['document']);

        return $document === null ? null : ['document' => $document, 'fileName' => $stored['fileName']];
    }

    public function forget(Team $team, User $user): void
    {
        $this->cache->forget($this->key($team, $user));
    }

    private function key(Team $team, User $user): string
    {
        return "configuration-import:{$team->id}:{$user->id}";
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Monitoring;

use App\Configuration\ConfigurationExporter;
use App\Configuration\ConfigurationFormat;
use App\Configuration\ConfigurationImporter;
use App\Configuration\ConfigurationReader;
use App\Configuration\ImportBlocked;
use App\Configuration\InvalidConfigurationFile;
use App\Configuration\PendingImport;
use App\Data\Pages\ConfigurationImportPageData;
use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Container\Attributes\CurrentUser;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\Response as HttpResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Inertia\Response;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\HeaderUtils;

class ConfigurationController extends Controller
{
    public function download(Team $current_team, ConfigurationExporter $exporter): HttpResponse
    {
        return response($exporter->toJson($exporter->export($current_team)), 200, [
            'Content-Type' => 'application/json; charset=UTF-8',
            'Content-Disposition' => HeaderUtils::makeDisposition(HeaderUtils::DISPOSITION_ATTACHMENT, $exporter->fileName($current_team)),
            'Cache-Control' => 'no-store',
        ]);
    }

    public function show(Team $current_team, #[CurrentUser] User $user, PendingImport $pending, ConfigurationImporter $importer): Response
    {
        $stored = $pending->get($current_team, $user);

        return Inertia::render('monitoring/configuration/Import', [
            'page' => new ConfigurationImportPageData(
                preview: $stored === null ? null : $importer->preview($current_team, $stored['document'], $stored['fileName']),
                maxKilobytes: intdiv(ConfigurationFormat::MAX_BYTES, 1024),
            ),
        ]);
    }

    public function upload(Request $request, Team $current_team, #[CurrentUser] User $user, ConfigurationReader $reader, PendingImport $pending): RedirectResponse
    {
        $request->validate(
            ['file' => ['required', 'file', 'max:'.intdiv(ConfigurationFormat::MAX_BYTES, 1024)]],
            [
                'file.required' => __('Choose a configuration file.'),
                'file.file' => __('Choose a configuration file.'),
                'file.max' => __('This file is larger than 1 MB.'),
            ],
        );

        /** @var UploadedFile $file */
        $file = $request->file('file');

        try {
            $document = $reader->read((string) $file->get());
        } catch (InvalidConfigurationFile $exception) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['file' => $exception->getMessage()]);
        }

        $pending->put($current_team, $user, $document, Str::limit($file->getClientOriginalName(), 120));

        return to_route('configuration.show', ['current_team' => $current_team->slug]);
    }

    public function discard(Team $current_team, #[CurrentUser] User $user, PendingImport $pending): RedirectResponse
    {
        $pending->forget($current_team, $user);

        return to_route('configuration.show', ['current_team' => $current_team->slug]);
    }

    public function apply(Request $request, Team $current_team, #[CurrentUser] User $user, PendingImport $pending, ConfigurationImporter $importer): RedirectResponse
    {
        $request->validate(['update' => ['boolean']]);

        $stored = $pending->get($current_team, $user);

        if ($stored === null) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['file' => __('Upload the file again: its preview has expired.')]);
        }

        try {
            $summary = $importer->apply($current_team, $stored['document'], $request->boolean('update'));
        } catch (ImportBlocked $exception) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['file' => $exception->getMessage()]);
        }

        $pending->forget($current_team, $user);

        Inertia::flash('toast', ['type' => 'success', 'message' => $summary->message()]);

        return to_route('applications.index', ['current_team' => $current_team->slug]);
    }
}
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Head, Link, router, useForm, usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { PhFileArrowUp, PhUploadSimple } from '@phosphor-icons/vue';
import { trans } from 'laravel-vue-i18n';
import { computed } from 'vue';
import FormErrors from '@/components/FormErrors.vue';
import InputError from '@/components/InputError.vue';
import PageHeader from '@/components/PageHeader.vue';
import PasswordNeededTag from '@/components/monitoring/PasswordNeededTag.vue';
import EnvPill from '@/components/nocturne/EnvPill.vue';
import SectionCard from '@/components/nocturne/SectionCard.vue';
import { useTeamSlug } from '@/composables/useTeamSlug';
import {
    importItemLabel,
    importOutcome,
    importStatusClass,
    importStatusLabel,
    importTotals,
} from '@/lib/configuration';
import { formatInstant } from '@/lib/datetime';
import { invalidField } from '@/lib/fieldErrors';
import { index as applicationsIndex } from '@/routes/applications';
import { apply, discard, upload } from '@/routes/configuration';

defineOptions({
    layout: { title: 'Import configuration' },
});

const { page } = defineProps<{
    page: App.Data.Pages.ConfigurationImportPageData;
}>();

const slug = useTeamSlug();
const inertiaPage = usePage();

const fileForm = useForm<{ file: File | null }>({ file: null });
const applyForm = useForm<{ update: boolean }>({ update: false });

const applyErrors = computed(
    () => applyForm.errors as Record<string, string | undefined>,
);
const fileError = computed(
    () =>
        fileForm.errors.file ??
        (page.preview ? undefined : applyErrors.value.file),
);

const items = computed(() => page.preview?.items ?? []);
const totals = computed(() => importTotals(items.value, applyForm.update));
const hasChanged = computed(() =>
    items.value.some((item) => item.status === 'changed'),
);
const nothingToDo = computed(
    () => totals.value.create + totals.value.update === 0,
);
const waitsForPassword = computed(() =>
    items.value.some((item) => item.passwordNeeded),
);

const origin = computed(() => {
    const preview = page.preview;

    if (!preview?.organization || !preview.exportedAt) {
        return null;
    }

    return trans('Exported from :organization · :time', {
        organization: preview.organization,
        time: formatInstant(preview.exportedAt, inertiaPage.props.locale),
    });
});

const pick = (event: Event): void => {
    fileForm.file = (event.target as HTMLInputElement).files?.[0] ?? null;
};

const sendFile = (): void => {
    fileForm.post(upload(slug.value).url, {
        forceFormData: true,
        preserveScroll: true,
    });
};

const chooseAnother = (): void => {
    applyForm.reset();
    applyForm.clearErrors();
    router.delete(discard(slug.value).url, { preserveScroll: true });
};

const runImport = (): void => {
    applyForm.post(apply(slug.value).url, { preserveScroll: true });
};
</script>

            <form
```
