### Task 9.7: Command line: `applications:export` and `applications:import`

Decisions: `-` reads standard input through `InputSource`, which reads at most 1 MB + 1 byte so an
oversized pipe stops early; a missing or unreadable path fails with "Cannot read :path."; the
preview table has the columns Item, Status, Details; an invalid file or an invalid item fails the
command and changes nothing.

**Files:**

- Create: `app/Configuration/InputSource.php`
- Modify: `app/Configuration/InvalidConfigurationFile.php` (new `unreadable()`)
- Create: `app/Console/Commands/ExportConfiguration.php`
- Create: `app/Console/Commands/ImportConfiguration.php`
- Modify: `lang/it.json`
- Test: `tests/Feature/Configuration/ConfigurationCommandsTest.php`

**Interfaces:**

- Consumes: `ConfigurationExporter` (9.2), `ConfigurationReader`, `InvalidConfigurationFile`
  (9.1), `ConfigurationImporter`, `ImportBlocked`, `ImportSummary::message()` (9.4),
  `ImportItemData`, `ImportItemKind`, `ImportItemStatus`.
- Produces: `InputSource(string $stdin = 'php://stdin')::read(string $path): string`,
  `InvalidConfigurationFile::unreadable(string $path)`, commands
  `applications:export {organization} {--output=}` and
  `applications:import {organization} {path} {--update} {--dry-run}`.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test `tests/Feature/Configuration/ConfigurationCommandsTest.php`**

```php
<?php

use App\Configuration\ConfigurationExporter;
use App\Configuration\InputSource;
use App\Enums\EnvironmentType;
use App\Models\Application;
use App\Models\Environment;
use App\Models\Team;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Tests\Support\ConfigurationFiles;

beforeEach(function () {
    $this->travelTo(CarbonImmutable::parse('2026-10-16 09:00:00'));
    $this->team = Team::factory()->create(['name' => 'Example Organization', 'slug' => 'example-organization']);
    $this->acme = Application::factory()->for($this->team)->create(['name' => 'Acme Shop']);
    $this->production = Environment::factory()->for($this->acme)->create([
        'name' => 'production',
        'type' => EnvironmentType::Production,
        'horizon_url' => 'https://shop.example.com/horizon',
        'basic_auth_user' => null,
        'basic_auth_password' => null,
        'poll_interval_seconds' => 60,
        'polling_enabled' => true,
    ]);

    $this->file = function (array $document): string {
        $path = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), 'horizon-watch-import-');
        file_put_contents($path, json_encode($document, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));

        return $path;
    };
    $this->document = ConfigurationFiles::document(
        applications: [
            ['name' => 'Acme Shop', 'environments' => [ConfigurationFiles::environment(['poll_interval_seconds' => 120])]],
            ['name' => 'Billing', 'environments' => [ConfigurationFiles::environment(['horizon_url' => 'https://billing.example.com/horizon'])]],
        ],
        alertRules: [['scope' => 'production', 'metric' => 'queue.max_wait', 'threshold' => 90]],
    );
});

test('the export command writes the file to standard output', function () {
    $this->artisan('applications:export', ['organization' => $this->team->slug])
        ->expectsOutputToContain('"format": "horizon-watch.config"')
        ->assertSuccessful();
});

test('the export command writes the file where --output says', function () {
    $path = sys_get_temp_dir().'/horizon-watch-export-'.uniqid().'.json';

    $this->artisan('applications:export', ['organization' => $this->team->slug, '--output' => $path])
        ->expectsOutput("Exported the configuration of Example Organization to {$path}.")
        ->assertSuccessful();

    $exporter = app(ConfigurationExporter::class);

    expect(file_get_contents($path))->toBe($exporter->toJson($exporter->export($this->team)));
});

test('both commands refuse an organization that does not exist', function (string $command, array $arguments) {
    $this->artisan($command, ['organization' => 'nowhere', ...$arguments])
        ->expectsOutput('No organization uses the slug nowhere.')
        ->assertFailed();
})->with([
    'export' => ['applications:export', []],
    'import' => ['applications:import', ['path' => '-']],
]);

test('a dry run prints the preview and changes nothing', function () {
    $this->artisan('applications:import', ['organization' => $this->team->slug, 'path' => ($this->file)($this->document), '--dry-run' => true])
        ->expectsTable(['Item', 'Status', 'Details'], [
            ['Acme Shop', 'unchanged', ''],
            ['Acme Shop / production', 'changed, skipped (use --update)', 'differs: poll_interval_seconds'],
            ['Billing', 'new', ''],
            ['Billing / production', 'new', ''],
            ['rule production / queue.max_wait', 'new', ''],
        ])
        ->expectsOutput('Dry run: nothing was changed.')
        ->assertSuccessful();

    expect(Application::where('team_id', $this->team->id)->count())->toBe(1)
        ->and($this->production->fresh()->poll_interval_seconds)->toBe(60)
        ->and($this->team->alertRules()->count())->toBe(0);
});

test('the import command reads standard input and updates only with --update', function () {
    $this->app->instance(InputSource::class, new InputSource(stdin: ($this->file)($this->document)));

    $this->artisan('applications:import', ['organization' => $this->team->slug, 'path' => '-'])
        ->expectsOutput('Configuration imported: 3 created, 0 updated, 2 left as they were.')
        ->assertSuccessful();

    expect($this->production->fresh()->poll_interval_seconds)->toBe(60);

    $this->artisan('applications:import', ['organization' => $this->team->slug, 'path' => '-', '--update' => true])
        ->expectsOutput('Configuration imported: 0 created, 1 updated, 4 left as they were.')
        ->assertSuccessful();

    expect($this->production->fresh()->poll_interval_seconds)->toBe(120);
});

test('a file with an invalid item fails and changes nothing', function () {
    $path = ($this->file)(ConfigurationFiles::document([
        ['name' => 'Billing', 'environments' => [ConfigurationFiles::environment(['name' => 'organization'])]],
    ]));

    $this->artisan('applications:import', ['organization' => $this->team->slug, 'path' => $path, '--update' => true])
        ->expectsOutput('The file has invalid items: fix them and run the import again. Nothing was changed.')
        ->assertFailed();

    expect(Application::where('name', 'Billing')->exists())->toBeFalse();
});

test('a file the panel cannot read stops the import with the reason', function () {
    $this->artisan('applications:import', ['organization' => $this->team->slug, 'path' => '/nonexistent/shop.json'])
        ->expectsOutput('Cannot read /nonexistent/shop.json.')
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Create `app/Configuration/InputSource.php`**

```php
<?php

namespace App\Configuration;

use ErrorException;

final readonly class InputSource
{
    public function __construct(private string $stdin = 'php://stdin') {}

    /**
     * Reads a configuration file, or standard input for "-", stopping one byte past the limit so
     * the reader can refuse an oversized file without holding all of it.
     *
     * @throws InvalidConfigurationFile
     */
    public function read(string $path): string
    {
        if ($path !== '-' && ! is_file($path)) {
            throw InvalidConfigurationFile::unreadable($path);
        }

        try {
            $handle = fopen($path === '-' ? $this->stdin : $path, 'rb');
        } catch (ErrorException) {
            $handle = false;
        }

        if ($handle === false) {
            throw InvalidConfigurationFile::unreadable($path);
        }

        try {
            $contents = stream_get_contents($handle, ConfigurationFormat::MAX_BYTES + 1);
        } finally {
            fclose($handle);
        }

        if ($contents === false) {
            throw InvalidConfigurationFile::unreadable($path);
        }

        return $contents;
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Create `app/Console/Commands/ExportConfiguration.php`**

```php
<?php

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use App\Configuration\ConfigurationExporter;
use App\Models\Team;
use ErrorException;
use Illuminate\Console\Attributes\Description;
use Illuminate\Console\Attributes\Signature;
use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface;

#[Signature('applications:export {organization : Slug of the organization} {--output= : Write the file here instead of to standard output}')]
#[Description('Export the applications, environments and alert rules of an organization as a configuration file, without any secret')]
class ExportConfiguration extends Command
{
    public function handle(ConfigurationExporter $exporter): int
    {
        $slug = (string) $this->argument('organization');
        $team = Team::query()->where('slug', $slug)->first();

        if ($team === null) {
            $this->error("No organization uses the slug {$slug}.");

            return self::FAILURE;
        }

        $json = $exporter->toJson($exporter->export($team));
        $output = $this->option('output');

        if (! is_string($output) || $output === '') {
            $this->output->write($json, false, OutputInterface::OUTPUT_RAW);

            return self::SUCCESS;
        }

        try {
            $written = file_put_contents($output, $json);
        } catch (ErrorException) {
            $written = false;
        }

        if ($written === false) {
            $this->error("Cannot write {$output}.");

            return self::FAILURE;
        }

        $this->info("Exported the configuration of {$team->name} to {$output}.");

        return self::SUCCESS;
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: Create `app/Console/Commands/ImportConfiguration.php`**

```php
<?php

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use App\Configuration\ConfigurationImporter;
use App\Configuration\ConfigurationReader;
use App\Configuration\ImportBlocked;
use App\Configuration\InputSource;
use App\Configuration\InvalidConfigurationFile;
use App\Data\Configuration\ImportItemData;
use App\Enums\ImportItemKind;
use App\Enums\ImportItemStatus;
use App\Models\Team;
use Illuminate\Console\Attributes\Description;
use Illuminate\Console\Attributes\Signature;
use Illuminate\Console\Command;

#[Signature('applications:import {organization : Slug of the organization} {path : The configuration file, or - to read standard input} {--update : Update the items that exist and differ from the file} {--dry-run : Print the preview and change nothing}')]
#[Description('Import applications, environments and alert rules from a configuration file; nothing is ever deleted')]
class ImportConfiguration extends Command
{
    public function handle(InputSource $input, ConfigurationReader $reader, ConfigurationImporter $importer): int
    {
        $slug = (string) $this->argument('organization');
        $team = Team::query()->where('slug', $slug)->first();

        if ($team === null) {
            $this->error("No organization uses the slug {$slug}.");

            return self::FAILURE;
        }

        $path = (string) $this->argument('path');
        $update = (bool) $this->option('update');

        try {
            $document = $reader->read($input->read($path));
        } catch (InvalidConfigurationFile $exception) {
            $this->error($exception->getMessage());

            return self::FAILURE;
        }

        $preview = $importer->preview($team, $document, $path === '-' ? 'stdin' : basename($path));

        $this->table(['Item', 'Status', 'Details'], array_map(fn (ImportItemData $item) => [
            $this->nameOf($item),
            $this->statusOf($item, $update),
            $this->detailsOf($item),
        ], $preview->items));

        if ($preview->blocked) {
            $this->error('The file has invalid items: fix them and run the import again. Nothing was changed.');

            return self::FAILURE;
        }

        if ($this->option('dry-run')) {
            $this->info('Dry run: nothing was changed.');

            return self::SUCCESS;
        }

        try {
            $summary = $importer->apply($team, $document, $update);
        } catch (ImportBlocked $exception) {
            $this->error($exception->getMessage());

            return self::FAILURE;
        }

        $this->info($summary->message());

        return self::SUCCESS;
    }

    private function nameOf(ImportItemData $item): string
    {
        return match ($item->kind) {
            ImportItemKind::Application => $item->label,
            ImportItemKind::Environment => $item->application.' / '.$item->label,
            ImportItemKind::AlertRule => 'rule '.$item->label,
        };
    }

    private function statusOf(ImportItemData $item, bool $update): string
    {
        if ($item->status !== ImportItemStatus::Changed) {
            return $item->status->value;
        }

        return $update ? 'changed, will be updated' : 'changed, skipped (use --update)';
    }

    private function detailsOf(ImportItemData $item): string
    {
        $details = $item->errors;

        if ($item->changes !== []) {
            $details[] = 'differs: '.implode(', ', $item->changes);
        }

        if ($item->passwordNeeded) {
            $details[] = 'password needed';
        }

        return implode('; ', $details);
    }
}
```

### Task 9.8: "Password needed" on the application page, the environment page and the edit form

Decision: the mark is the neutral `PasswordNeededTag`, placed next to the address on the
application page's environment card, in the address line of the environment page (desktop) and
under the freshness line on mobile, and as a notice at the top of the Edit environment form.

Decision: the Edit environment page gets no new prop. It already receives
`page.environment.basicAuthUser` and `page.hasPassword`
(`StoredPasswordStaysWithItsAddress::hasStoredPassword()`, the same raw-attribute check as
`waitsForPassword()`), so it derives the mark from them. A `passwordNeeded` key on
`EnvironmentFormPageData` would repeat that information, and would break
`ApplicationFormPagesTest`'s `test('no form page prop is a password field, and none carries the stored one', …)`,
which allows `hasPassword` as the only form page key containing "password". That test stays as it
is and keeps guarding the form pages.

- [ ] **Step 1: README.** Insert, right before the line `## Troubleshooting`:

````markdown
## Moving the configuration to another panel

An organization's applications, environments and alert rules travel as one JSON file: to a new
server, to a fresh install after a major upgrade, or to a staging panel. The file never holds a
secret: no basic-auth password, no webhook signing secret and no credentials inside a URL (they
are stripped). Notification settings, maintenance windows, members, invitations, readings and
alerts stay behind.

In the panel, admins and owners use **Export** and **Import** on the Applications page. Import
shows a preview first, with every application, environment and rule marked new, changed (with
the fields that differ), unchanged or invalid (with the reason). Changed items are left as they
are unless you turn on **Update existing items**; nothing is ever deleted, and one invalid item
blocks the import until the file is fixed. Every item goes through the same checks as the forms,
the Horizon URL check at save included, so a hand-edited file can do no more than the forms can.
The file is at most 1 MB.

From the command line the organization is named by its slug, the first part of the panel's
addresses after the host. `-` reads the file from standard input, so it does not have to be inside
the container; `--dry-run` prints the preview and changes nothing; `--update` updates the items
that differ:

```bash
docker compose -f compose.prod.yaml run --rm -T web artisan applications:export shop > shop.json
docker compose -f compose.prod.yaml run --rm -T web artisan applications:import shop - --dry-run < shop.json
docker compose -f compose.prod.yaml run --rm -T web artisan applications:import shop - < shop.json
```

The organization must exist on the target panel: create it first. Applications are matched by
name whatever the case, environments by name within their application, alert rules by scope and
metric. An environment with a basic-auth user arrives without its password and with collection
paused, marked **Password needed** on the application page, the environment page and its edit
form: type the password there, then turn collection on. An environment that already exists with
the same user and host keeps its stored password.

`version` in the file is the version of the file format. A newer panel reads the files of an older
one; an older panel refuses a newer file and asks to be updated first.
````

```markdown
Export or import an organization's applications, environments and alert rules, see
[Moving the configuration to another panel](#moving-the-configuration-to-another-panel).
```

```markdown
  marked **Password needed**, until their password is typed. See the README's _Moving the

```
